mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sq_execution_activity ( activity_id, user_id, scope_id, conversation_id, source_message_id, execution_id, task_id, job_id, binding_id, run_id, turn_id, source_key, plan_version, activity_type, activity_group, status, wait_reason, safe_summary, started_at, ended_at, version, native_sequence ) VALUES ( #{activityId}, #{userId}, #{scopeId}, #{conversationId}, #{sourceMessageId}, #{executionId}, #{taskId}, #{jobId}, #{bindingId}, #{runId}, #{turnId}, #{sourceKey}, #{planVersion}, #{type}, #{group}, #{status}, #{waitReason}, #{summary}, #{startedAt}, #{endedAt}, #{version}, #{nativeSequence} )
mapper.select: SELECT binding_id FROM sq_runtime_binding WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND scope_id = #{scopeId} AND role = 'MASTER' AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(r.source_message_id, t.origin_message_id) FROM sq_execution_scope s LEFT JOIN sq_response_execution r ON r.user_id = s.user_id AND r.scope_id = s.scope_id LEFT JOIN sq_goal_task t ON t.user_id = s.user_id AND t.scope_id = s.scope_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.scope_id = #{scopeId} AND s.del_flag = '0'

FROM sq_execution_activity WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND binding_id = #{bindingId} AND source_key = #{sourceKey} AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.update: UPDATE sq_execution_activity SET status = #{status}, wait_reason = #{waitReason}, started_at = #{startedAt}, ended_at = #{endedAt}, version = #{version}, native_sequence = #{nativeSequence} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND activity_id = #{activityId} AND native_sequence < #{nativeSequence} AND version = #{version} - 1
